follow_ups.observation: The --out-dir containment guard is check-then-use. resolveNearestExisting resolves symlinks only on the nearest existing ancestor and re-appends the not-yet-existing remainder as literal, unchecked segments; the guard runs once in runCheckMode while writeLog's os.MkdirAll/os.WriteFile run later, and those follow symlinks on intermediate components. A remainder segment that becomes a symlink into the repository root between guard and write lands the log inside the frozen candidate. Refuted as a blocker for this candidate: the base guard resolved no symlinks at all, so a symlink planted before the run was accepted outright with no race required. The candidate narrows this class from static to race-only; the residual exposure is pre-existing, and the attacker capability it requires (timed writes into the out-dir's parent) already subsumes the impact via simpler routes such as poisoning the tools exec.LookPath resolves.
